case_name: Shane Roy Needham v. Janet Lea Needham

issues.label: Standard of appellate review
issues.why: The court must identify the correct standard for reviewing discretionary property-division decisions and related factual findings.

issues.label: Jurisdiction after reserved issue
issues.why: The court must confirm the magistrate retained authority to decide disposition of the reserved community stock post-decree.

issues.label: Community vs separate characterization
issues.why: The court must determine whether Alturas shares (and any increases) are community property subject to division.

issues.label: Valuation date selection
issues.why: The court must decide whether shares must be valued at divorce, trial, or another equitable date.

issues.label: Need to value before dividing
issues.why: The court must address whether Idaho law requires a specific valuation when making an in-kind stock division.

issues.label: Equal division requirement
issues.why: The court must ensure the distribution is substantially equal absent findings supporting an unequal division.

issues.label: Statutory factor application
issues.why: The court must apply Idaho Code § 32-712 factors and explain how they support the chosen method of division.

issues.label: Disentanglement consideration
issues.why: The court must consider whether the chosen remedy properly minimizes ongoing entanglement between ex-spouses.

issues.label: In-kind division propriety
issues.why: The court must decide if splitting closely held shares in-kind is equitable and feasible under Idaho precedent.

issues.label: Buyout alternative consideration
issues.why: The court must decide whether to permit/require a monetary award and buyout plan instead of share transfer.

issues.label: Installment payment authority
issues.why: The court must address whether it may order installment payments and under what terms (security, interest, duration).

issues.label: Deadlock findings relevance
issues.why: The court must determine whether corporate governance deadlock is a proper equitable consideration in dividing marital property.

issues.label: Speculation about future success
issues.why: The court must assess whether findings like company “more successful without” a spouse are supported and legally relevant.

issues.label: Effect on voting control value
issues.why: The court must address whether reallocating shares changes the economic value/control premium and risks an unequal division.

issues.label: Marketability minority discount issues
issues.why: The court must consider whether minority status/transfer restrictions affect value and fairness of the distribution.

issues.label: Dividend allocation post-decree
issues.why: The court must account for dividends received between decree and trial and whether equalization is needed.

issues.label: Natural enhancement allocation
issues.why: The court must decide how post-decree appreciation attributable to market forces vs efforts should be allocated.

issues.label: Waste or dissipation claims
issues.why: The court must consider whether either spouse’s conduct (e.g., competition, litigation) constitutes dissipation affecting division.

issues.label: BSA enforceability against spouse
issues.why: The court must determine whether Ms. Needham is bound by the Buy-Sell Agreement and its transfer restrictions.

issues.label: Involuntary transfer clause effect
issues.why: The court must interpret whether a divorce decree transfer is an “involuntary transfer by operation of law/court decree” triggering the BSA.

issues.label: Book value vs fair value tension
issues.why: The court must address whether enforcing the BSA would force repurchase at book value and whether that is equitable in divorce.

issues.label: Authority to compel waiver
issues.why: The court must decide whether a divorce court may order a party to sign a waiver/consent affecting third-party contractual rights.

issues.label: Whether waiver modifies BSA
issues.why: The court must decide if the proposed waiver is merely a consent under the BSA or an amendment requiring formalities/consideration.

issues.label: Corporate consent validity
issues.why: The court must assess whether required corporate/shareholder approvals occurred and whether lack of Mr. Needham’s consent matters.

issues.label: Third-party rights and joinder
issues.why: The court must consider whether the corporation/other shareholders’ interests require joinder or limit the divorce court’s orders.

issues.label: Specific performance feasibility
issues.why: The court must determine whether ordering execution of the waiver is sufficiently definite and enforceable.

issues.label: Remedy if waiver refused
issues.why: The court must identify enforcement mechanisms or alternative remedies if Mr. Needham will not sign.

issues.label: Fiduciary duty implications
issues.why: The court must consider whether compelling actions affecting corporate governance implicates fiduciary duties of directors/shareholders.

issues.label: Board seat jeopardy relevance
issues.why: The court must decide whether potential loss of board position is legally relevant to equitable distribution.

issues.label: Closely held stock transferability
issues.why: The court must address whether the shares are transferable to a non-employee former spouse under corporate documents and practice.

issues.label: Precedent interpretation (Josephson)
issues.why: The court must correctly interpret when Idaho cases favor awarding the business to the operating spouse rather than splitting stock.

issues.label: Precedent interpretation (Lamm)
issues.why: The court must apply any controlling principles from Lamm regarding business valuation/division and equitable powers.

issues.label: Requirement of findings/record support
issues.why: The court must ensure the magistrate made adequate findings on key facts (deadlock, value effects, equities) supported by evidence.

issues.label: Abuse of discretion framework
issues.why: The court must apply the correct multi-step abuse-of-discretion analysis to the magistrate’s choice of remedy.

issues.label: District court appellate role
issues.why: The court must ensure the district court used the correct standard when reviewing the magistrate as an intermediate appellate court.

issues.label: Attorney fees on appeal standard
issues.why: The court must decide whether the district court properly found the appeal frivolous/unreasonable and applied the correct fee authority.

issues.label: Due process and notice issues
issues.why: The court must consider whether ordering execution of a waiver shortly before/after trial provided adequate notice and opportunity to be heard.

issues.label: Equitable power limits
issues.why: The court must determine the outer limits of divorce court equity when orders impact nonparty corporate arrangements.

issues.label: Form of judgment clarity
issues.why: The court must ensure the judgment precisely identifies the shares, transfer mechanics, and timing to avoid future disputes.
